lxc_32b5051c20694923.text: Seoul is the capital of South Korea, a country in East Asia.

lxc_76472d8f7d2e4fdd.text: You will read about a historic food market, a royal palace, and a busy shopping street.

lxc_2df31ec86792b524.text: Then you will practise three real conversations: ordering food, asking about the subway, and choosing a jacket size.

lxc_f87db6384191d500.text: Gwangjang Market is a historic market in Seoul.

lxc_10d2046238d595bc.text: It has food stalls and shops for clothing and fabric.

lxc_1fa94c685b082a05.text: Two foods to try are mayak gimbap and nokdujeon.

lxc_2f1c2695a4dde45c.text: Mayak gimbap are small rice rolls, and nokdujeon are savoury pancakes made from mung beans.

lxc_61c34fd10690a9a9.text: Another important Korean food is kimchi.

lxc_4f44a5d05c9d0bea.text: Families and communities make and share kimchi in a tradition called kimjang.

lxc_7cd58ec7a1cbcfb6.text: UNESCO added kimjang to its Intangible Cultural Heritage list in 2013.

lxc_a40e1e7face088f3.text: Gyeongbokgung was the main royal palace of the Joseon dynasty.

lxc_7a694cbbb6b0b3ae.text: Its name expresses a wish for the new dynasty to enjoy great fortune and prosperity.

lxc_342513db196d2ce5.text: Important cultural work took place there, including work connected to Hunminjeongeum, the original name of the Korean alphabet.

lxc_b16f24c63507f5d8.text: The palace was destroyed in 1592 and restored in 1867.

lxc_97663787f2bcfe66.text: If you travel there, check a current subway map and ask for help when you need it.

lxc_3763ae476b93b559.text: Myeong-dong is a shopping area in central Seoul.

lxc_df92247cf3ccbfab.text: It is known for fashion and food.

lxc_33974cd79bd6c580.text: The area also has Myeong-dong Cathedral and two major department stores.

lxc_990cab1351f96aaf.text: You can visit shops, compare clothes, and stop for something to eat.

lxc_0fdd69d13e17ab8f.text: When you buy clothes, check the label because size systems can be different.

lxc_50f33084d9e8aefc.text: If you are not sure, ask, ‘What size is this?’ or ‘Can I try this on?’

lxc_fc1c2cc9528d0e0f.text: The vendor smiles and waits for your order.

lxc_862accbfe0fb1dae.text: Your goal is to order one pancake, ask for water, and confirm the price.

lxc_13209f4b523157d5.text: Your goal is to find the train direction, confirm whether you need to change, and choose the palace exit.

lxc_145380c83e3d6091.text: Your goal is to understand the Korean size number and ask to try the jacket on.
